text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/generate streaming endpoints exceeded SLO (target 1.5s, current p99 5.9s) across eu-west region. Affected model: rwd-llama-3-70b-int8-calib-v3. Rollout window: 22:10 UTC. Auto-notify on-call.

maria_voss: seeing large tail spikes, looks correlated with recent quantization calibration push earlier tonight. p95 up to 2.3s, p99 ~5.9s, errors for streaming chunk flushes.

li_chen_oncall: oncall here — paging in. checking logs + traces now. any customer impact reports?

josh_kim: I can confirm backend queueing: worker KV cache miss times spiked. Streams were stuck waiting on dequant step. Suspect dequant KV contention introduced by int8 kernel change.

emma_valdez: CS reported 3 premium customers in EU-west seeing incomplete responses / stalled streams. Frank G reported two customer sessions timeout and reconnected.

frank_g: customer A (search-saas) logged multiple incomplete streaming sessions, they saw partial payloads and then reconnects. They asked for timeline and mitigation.

danielle_ruiz: adding telemetry: attaching quick metrics snapshot: ```
model=rwd-llama-3-70b-int8-calib-v3
region=eu-west
p95=2.3
p99=5.9
error_rate_streaming_chunk=0.8% -> 3.5% during peak
avg_inflight_per_worker=18 -> normal 4
KV_dequant_latency_95=1.1s
```

maria_voss: steps proposed: 1) route EU-west streaming traffic to fallback pool that uses fp16/fp32 variant (non-int8) 2) throttle batching (lower max_batch_size) 3) if routing not possible, roll back calibration profile. Thoughts?

li_chen_oncall: agree. Priority is restore customer streaming health. I'll open an immediate routing override to fallback pool and scale dedicated pool +2 replicas.

josh_kim: routing override command (run by infra): ```bash
redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --selector "model:rwd-llama-3-70b*" --target-pool rwd-eu-fallback-nonquant
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool rwd-eu-fallback-nonquant --replicas +2
```

nina_patel: FYI this will increase unit cost but OK for outage window. Notify CS and update status page.

emma_valdez: I'll post interim update to customers and open a ticket for Customer A. ETA to customers for mitigation?

li_chen_oncall: routing override applied at 22:35 UTC. initial metrics show drop in p99 to 1.8s within 3 minutes. streaming stalls reduced.

maria_voss: good recovery signal. keep monitoring for 30m. we should still investigate root cause of int8 calibration fallout.

josh_kim: preliminary root cause: the int8 calibration change introduced a KV layout change that increased dequantization memcopys under certain sequence-length bursts, causing higher per-token stalls and backpressure on streaming flush threads. Repro locally with long-context streaming load.

danielle_ruiz: repro steps (dev env): ```
# simulate long streaming session
wrk -t12 -c200 -d120s --script stream_long.lua http://test-eu/generate
# observe worker threads blocked in dequant memcpy
sudo perf top -p <pid> # shows memcpy + dequant kernel
```

maria_voss: can we hotfix by patching kernel to avoid memcopy path? If not quick, schedule rollback of calib profile to previous v2.

josh_kim: hotpatch will need a build and restart of runtime; estimate 45-60m to build + canary. Rollback calibration profile is faster. We can do a rollback to `rwd-llama-3-70b-int8-calib-v2` which was stable.

li_chen_oncall: propose immediate plan: A) keep routing override to fallback pool B) rollback calibration to v2 in eu-west for int8 variant at 23:15 UTC C) run synthetic streaming smoke for 15m D) if v2 stable, re-enable routing back to int8 later with canary at low traffic.

nina_patel: communication plan: - Status page: incident in progress - Notify affected customers (Emma) - Postmortem owner: Maria + Josh + Danielle.

emma_valdez: messaging draft to customers: "We detected elevated streaming latency and incomplete streams in EU-west after a model calibration update. We've routed traffic to a non-quantized fallback pool and are rolling back the calibration to restore normal streaming behavior. No data loss. We'll follow up with RCA." Send?

frank_g: send now. customer A already acknowledged and appreciates quick rollback plan.

incidentbot: note created: INCIDENT-2026-3795 - "EU-west streaming p99 spike after int8 calibration" owner: maria_voss. Pager escalations set to on-call schedule.

maria_voss: rolling back calibration to v2 now (command): ```bash
redwoodctl model-calib rollback --model rwd-llama-3-70b-int8 --to rwd-llama-3-70b-int8-calib-v2 --region eu-west
```

li_chen_oncall: rollback triggered at 23:16 UTC. will monitor metrics.

josh_kim: telemetry after rollback (23:25 UTC): p95 1.2s, p99 1.9s, error_rate_streaming_chunk back to 0.7%. Looks stable on initial checks.

maria_voss: great. plan to keep routing override until we validate for 60 more minutes then do controlled canary if we want to redeploy v3 after patches.

nina_patel: postmortem checklist assigned: - timeline & diff - diagnostic repro - kernel path analysis - test coverage gaps for long-context streaming - improvements to rollout gating for calibration profiles. Owner: maria_voss, josh_kim, danielle_ruiz.

li_chen_oncall: I'll close pager when we meet stability target for 1h. current mode: mitigation active (routing override + rollback).

maria_voss: adding follow-ups: create a regression test that exercises dequant memcopy path under high sequence-length streaming; add a canary gate for quant calibrations that includes streaming P99 trackers.

emma_valdez: customers updated. I'll schedule follow-up 1:1 with Customer A to walk them through RCA once available.

incidentbot: INCIDENT-2026-3795 updated: state=mitigated, mitigation=traffic routed to fallback pool + calib rollback, status=monitoring.

maria_voss: thanks team. will capture notes and start the postmortem draft. please add any log snippets or traces to the incident doc.
